==About==

Crafting {{i|Delectable Dumplings}} will make an {{i|Unboiled Delectable Dumplings}} which can then be boiled in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}} for 3 minutes to produce Delectable Dumplings. Unboiled Delectable Dumplings will become {{i|Spoiled Food}} if not boiled within 3 days and Delectable Dumplings will become Spoiled Food if not eaten within 3 days. Delectable Dumplings is [[Gluttony#Double Variable Recipe|Double Variable Recipe]].
